newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea to offer $15 mln soft loan to Ecuador.
newsitem.headline: South Korea to offer $15 mln soft loan to Ecuador.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Korea said on Tuesday it has signed agreements to provide $15 million in soft loans to Ecuador from the Seoul government's Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF).
The loan is being extended to help finance Ecuador's rural telecommunication Korea-Ecuador (Treck) project, a statement from Eximbank said.

The project to install 21,100 digital lines with time division exchange (TDX) switching systems is expected to contribute to economic development by improving telephone services in the Ecuadorian rural area, it said.
The loan will carry an annual interest rate of 3.0 percent and will be repayable over 20 years after a grace period of five years.
The South Korean government has so far committed $761 million loans for 53 projects in 22 countries.
